title: ReattachSettled names the requested pair for a stepped-down rung attempt
description:
ReattachSettled re-describes a settled attempt from the dispatch when the orchestrator's disk is gone, and its record names Options' Model/Harness — the pair the dispatch RESOLVED, not the pair that ran. Until y38 the two were invariantly equal (Start's model check guaranteed it); since y38's step-down acceptance a rung dispatch may have run the rung's declared Workers AI fallback instead, and the door's status route names no model, so the re-description cannot learn the truth: the record, and the handle it returns, would name claude/<alias> over work that ran pi-durable/<fallback>. A fix needs the status route to name the recorded boot's pair (the factory already records it, d1BootRecord.modelOf) and the reattach to prefer it over the dispatch's resolution.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:684 (ReattachSettled's record names e.opts.Model/e.opts.Harness); the status route's answer carries no model, cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts:120
